hec.model

Class SeasonalRecord

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.model.SeasonalRecord
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable

    public class SeasonalRecord
extends java.lang.Object
implements AsciiSerializable, java.lang.Cloneable
    Contains a set of date-values pairs representing seasonal variation of a value. Methods include string I/O and interpolation functions.
    Author:
    John F. DeGeorge, RMA
    See Also:
    Serialized Form
